entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought these ridiculously expensive cycling shoes from you, and they are complete garbage. I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you, and I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Alex Chen, order number 881-456. And don't 'look into it,' just process the return. These things gave me horrible blisters after one ride. ONE. I even set the cleats up perfectly.

Thank you, Alex. I've pulled up your order for the VeloPro Carbon cycling shoes. I understand they're causing blisters, which is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a sizing or preference issue?

Are you kidding me? It's an 'issue' that your product is defective! It's unwearable. I'm not here to debate preferences, I'm here for a refund. Are you going to give me one or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, Alex. There's no need for a manager, I can absolutely handle this for you. I just need to confirm the return eligibility based on our policy. One moment.

Unbelievable. If I don't see a return label in my email in the next five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. This is the worst service I've ever had.

Okay, Alex, I've confirmed everything on my end. Your order was delivered 8 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can approve this return for a full refund right now. I'm processing it as we speak.
Oh. So... you're approving it then?

Yes, absolutely. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid return shipping label and instructions. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives the item, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Right. Okay. Well, that's what I wanted. So... the label is on its way?
Yes, it should be in your inbox within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Alex?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
